name: The Day it Rained Roses
source:
In this fusion of the little mermaid and beauty and the beast (+ many more fairytales),  a solitary ex-prince vampire who longs for the companionship of a long lost friend, meets the fangirl of his dreams who stumbles upon his castle one day, and changes his life forever.

[From [url=https://butterblanc.itch.io/the-day-it-rained-roses]itch.io[/url]]
